decision.reasoning_trace: Selected products with high ratings, large review counts, and descriptions that mention features relevant to running shoes, such as cushioning, support, and breathability. ASICS Women's Gel-Nimbus 18 Running Shoe (prod_running_shoes_114) was chosen as the final product due to its high rating (4.5), large review count (727), and description that highlights its modernized geometry of cushioning and improved guidance line technology.
